definitions.explanation: An object used or capable of being used to harm or kill someone. In legal and news contexts, refers to any object used as a weapon in a crime, whether a knife, blunt instrument, or other item.

examples.japanese: {凶器|きょうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧だった。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凶器|きょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal fled with the weapon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{凶器|きょうき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}われる→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}した→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
examples.english: Police found a kitchen knife believed to be the weapon near the scene.

notes:
USAGE:
{凶器|きょうき} specifically refers to an object used as a weapon in a violent act. It is most commonly encountered in news reports and legal contexts. Any everyday object can become a {凶器|きょうき} if used to harm someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凶器|きょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to carry a weapon)
- {凶器|きょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use a weapon)
- {凶器|きょうき}⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧{罪|ざい} (crime of assembling with weapons prepared — a legal term)
- {鈍器|どんき} (blunt weapon — a related term)

WRITING:
The character ⟦{凶|きょう}→凶：19345_kyou⟧ means bad luck or evil, as in ⟦{凶悪|きょうあく}→凶悪：28175_kyouaku⟧ (atrocious). {器|き} means instrument or vessel.
